name: North Dwarka
notes:
Coastal city. Site of Dwarka Gate anomaly and celestial festivals.

One of several Dwarkas on Jambhudweep. This is the northern one -- the harbour with the Gate, and the one the game walks. The name was bare `Dwarka` while canon held only one, which stopped being true; `Dwarka` is kept as an alias so older references still read.
